verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Cloud Billing REST API for managing billing programmatically and a Budget API that tracks actual spend against planned spend, with Pub/Sub notifications. That gives some programmatic access to cost signals. However, nothing shows cost data being queryable at line-item level, nor any scheduled cost export. Missing for 10: scheduled billing/cost exports (e.g. to a queryable data store), resource-level cost granularity, a documented cost-query API rather than billing-account management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
